title: Triage leaves a request to confirm a payment to the user

messages.subject: Garden Room on 14 March
messages.body:
Hello Rowan,

As agreed on the phone, Sam Lee would like to book the Garden Room for the workshop on 14 March, from 10:00 to 16:00, for 18 people.

Best regards,
Assistant, assistant to Sam Lee

messages.subject: Re: Garden Room on 14 March
messages.body:
Hi,

Received, thanks. To hold the room, please confirm that you agree to the deposit of 260 EUR, payable by Friday.

Best,
Rowan Hart
Harbour Hall
